description: Display keyword x ad_unit request / response / response-rate for a marketplace over a period, from the display filtered-level performance facts. Follow-up breakdown to the display keyword RR report: one row per (keyword, ad_unit). Filter by keyword and/or ad_unit to scope; no spend / no currency conversion.

keyword.description: The targeted display keyword (filter_keywords, lowercased). Filterable.

ad_unit.description: The display ad unit / inventory slot the request was attributed to. Filterable.

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Display ad requests received for this keyword x ad_unit.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Requests that returned at least one ad (responses) for this keyword x ad_unit.

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = responses / requests * 100 for this keyword x ad_unit.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_display_ads_filtered_level_performance_facts` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND r.filter_keywords IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.filter_keywords) != '' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
